events.name: Bash
events.head: Check walkthrough checkout, review pages and ledger
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthrough* 2>/dev/null && pwd && git status --short | head -5; git log --oneline | head -3; ls scripts/walkthroughs | head -30; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia twilio dodo google-senders; do printf "%s " $t; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/$t/index.html?v=t283c"; done; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html?v=t283c"; tail -8 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-300; grep -n "T-283" -A12 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tasks/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run verify on the 8 tools and scan for stale access wording
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && sed -n 1,30p scripts/walkthroughs/verify.py | grep -n "argv\|usage\|Usage" | head; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia twilio dodo google-senders; do echo "== $t"; python3 scripts/walkthroughs/verify.py $t 2>&1 | tail -2 | cut -c1-200; done; ls app/public/wt-review | head -30; grep -il "waiting for access\|waiting on access\|blocked on account" app/public/wt-review/*/index.html app/public/wt-review/index.html scripts/walkthroughs/journeys/*.md 2>/dev/null | head
